title: Screensaver engine: pluggable sources, Settings picker and idle hook

needs: Owner decision (crow hub req_015 track 1, 2026-11-03): a full-screen screensaver when the machine idles, with the engine in archeotech-shell. Settings picker near the Power pane idle settings, live preview, shuffle, and screensaver sources as plugins so new ones are easy to add.

Source kinds: terminal animation (cmatrix/unimatrix, pipes.sh, asciiquarium, cbonsai, tty-clock, ASCII Star Wars asciimation from a local copy, ascii-magic's 734 MIT animated pieces via `npx ascii-magic-art`), QML scenes (including original ones), and a web page.

crow ships a screensaver plugin later (like integrations/archeotech/crow-agents): a 'CR-0W is working' card with run bars, modes overlay / take over / off, default overlay on top of the active source. The engine must allow a plugin card drawn above the active source.
Owner wants original ideas too, beyond the classic Linux animations. Placed in road_001 0.60 First impression (owner, 2026-11-05).
context: Idle today: swayidle is started by config/.config/swayidle/config.sh (dotfiles) with dim / lock / sleep timeouts read from ~/.cache/swayidle.conf; PowerPane.qml edits those values and re-runs the script. The shell has no idle behaviour of its own.

A layer-shell overlay cannot host a terminal, so terminal sources need a fullscreen kitty window with a compositor rule (MangoWC windowrule and Hyprland windowrule), or a terminal emulator embedded in QML; check before designing.
Plugins: modules/<id>/module.json + entry QML per docs/MODULE_API.md, with configSchema for per-instance settings. A screensaver source can be a new canLiveIn target or its own manifest kind.
IPC: shell.qml exposes IpcHandler targets (theme, launcher, settings, panel, osd, ...). The swayidle hook will call a new `screensaver` target before the lock; the dotfiles change is its own item.
Absorbs item_085 (idle and screensaver mode). item_158 (Cyberdeck crow agents and screensaver look) builds on this engine.
Safety: testing stays isolated (shot.sh / desk-check.py); never trigger the live session's idle or screensaver.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: A `screensaver` IPC target starts, stops and previews the screensaver; any input dismisses it and returns focus to the previous window.
AC2: Sources are plugins discovered from a manifest; QML, terminal and web sources each have at least one working example, and adding a source needs no core edit.
AC3: Settings (Power pane, next to the idle timeouts) picks a source or shuffle, shows a live preview, and sets the screensaver timeout before the lock.
AC4: swayidle starts the screensaver through the IPC target before the lock timeout, on MangoWC and Hyprland.
AC5: A plugin card layer (overlay / take over / off) can draw above the active source; a demo card proves the contract that crow will use.
AC6: Mockup options for the picker, preview and overlay card are rendered and the owner picks one before the UI is built.

product.title: Screensaver engine
product.overview: An idle screensaver for the Archeotech shell with pluggable sources (terminal, QML, web), a Settings picker with live preview and shuffle, and an overlay card layer for plugins such as crow.
goals: The machine shows something alive when idle, picked from Settings in two keystrokes.
New screensavers are a plugin drop-in, not a core change.
crow and identity packs can show their own card or look on top.
non_goals: The lock screen itself (item_018) and DPMS / suspend policy.
Shipping crow's own card (it lives in the crow repo).
Bundling third-party animations whose licence forbids it.

backlog_items.title: Screensaver mockups: picker, preview and overlay card options
problem: The picker, preview and overlay card are visual choices; the owner picks from rendered options before any UI build (standing rule).
scope_in: 2-3 options for the Power pane picker (list with thumbnails, gallery, compact selector plus preview), the live preview placement, and the overlay card (corner card, lower band, centred).
Rendered at 1920x1200 with shot.sh --qml standalone mocks, on dark and light, combined into one review page.
At least two original QML scene ideas sketched beyond the classic terminal animations.
scope_out: Engine code, plugins and the idle hook.
acceptance_criteria: AC6: The owner has picked a picker layout, a preview placement and an overlay card style; the pick is recorded in this item.

backlog_items.title: Screensaver engine core: IPC target, fullscreen host and dismissal
problem: The shell has no screensaver surface, no IPC entry to start one and no layer where a plugin card can draw over it.
scope_in: `screensaver` IpcHandler target: start, stop, preview <source>, status.
Fullscreen host per screen (all outputs) with dismissal on any key, pointer move or click, restoring focus.
Card layer above the source with modes overlay / take over / off and a demo card.
Terminal-source host decision recorded as an ADR: kitty fullscreen window + compositor rule versus an embedded terminal.
Reduce motion and the 114 animation scale respected by the engine's own fades.
scope_out: Individual sources (own item), Settings UI, swayidle changes.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: `qs ipc call screensaver start` in an isolated session shows the active source on every output and any input dismisses it.
AC5: A demo card draws over the source in overlay mode and replaces it in take-over mode.

backlog_items.title: Screensaver source plugins: QML, terminal and web examples
problem: Sources must be drop-in plugins so new screensavers need no core edit.
scope_in: Manifest kind for screensaver sources (module.json) with name, kind (qml / terminal / web), preview hint and configSchema.
QML: at least one original scene (reusing OrbitViz or the canvas work is fine) and a clock.
Terminal: cmatrix/unimatrix, pipes.sh, asciiquarium, cbonsai, tty-clock, a local ASCII Star Wars copy, ascii-magic via npx; each declares its package and is hidden when missing.
Web: a URL source, sandboxed, off by default.
scope_out: Bundling animation binaries or third-party art in the repo.
acceptance_criteria: AC2: A new source added under modules/ appears in the picker without core edits; one source of each kind plays in an isolated render.

backlog_items.title: Screensaver settings: source picker, shuffle, live preview, timeout
problem: The owner needs to pick, preview and time the screensaver next to the existing idle settings.
scope_in: Power pane section in the layout picked in the mockup item: source or shuffle (ButtonGroupRow / list per design rules), live preview, timeout before lock, card mode (overlay / take over / off) when a card plugin is installed.
Values persisted with the idle settings (~/.cache/swayidle.conf gains SCREENSAVER_* keys) and in settings search.
acceptance_criteria: AC3: Choosing a source updates the preview live, shuffle rotates sources between runs, and the timeout is written where the idle hook reads it.

backlog_items.title: Dotfiles idle hook: swayidle starts the shell screensaver before the lock
problem: Idle detection stays in the dotfiles; swayidle must call the shell's screensaver IPC before locking.
scope_in: config/.config/swayidle/config.sh: a SCREENSAVER timeout calling `qs -c archeotech ipc call screensaver start`, resume calling stop, ordered before dim and lock.
Kitty fullscreen windowrule for terminal sources in mango and hyprland configs.
Animation tools listed as optional in docs/PACKAGES.md and install-packages.sh.
scope_out: Testing on the owner's live session (the owner checks it; isolated tests only).
acceptance_criteria: AC4: After the screensaver timeout the screensaver starts, input stops it, and the lock still follows at its own timeout on MangoWC and Hyprland.

orchestration_task.title: Orchestrate the screensaver engine
plan: Render picker, preview and overlay card options; owner picks (mockup item).
Decide the terminal-source host (kitty window + rule vs embedded) as an ADR, then build the engine core with the IPC target and card layer.
Source plugins: QML first, then terminal, then web.
Settings section in the picked layout.
Dotfiles swayidle hook and window rules; owner checks on the live desk.
Retire item_085 as absorbed; hand item_158 and the crow card the card-layer contract.
